resources.string: Sign in with your own Google account. Recordings and notes are saved there — never to someone else’s account.
What you say is written in the language you spoke. Summaries and the day list use this setting.

Drive and Docs: save each recording and a written note (full transcript plus a short summary) in a folder this app creates. It cannot see the rest of your Drive.

Gmail: show a few recent messages from your primary inbox, in plain language. This app cannot send email.

Calendar: show what is first today. This app cannot add or change events.
